exposure: Intrauterine insemination with controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (IUI-COH)
In vitro fertilization (IVF) with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI)
outcome: Small for gestational age (SGA) with birth weight <10th percentile
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Primiparous women in the Netherlands who delivered opposite-sex dizygotic twins between January 2000 and December 2012, categorized by conception method (medically assisted reproduction or natural conception).
finding: Overall, maternal and perinatal risks for twin pregnancies conceived after medically assisted reproduction were similar to those after natural conception, though specific MAR methods showed some differential risks such as lower hypertension risk for IVF-ICSI and higher Apgar score <7 and perinatal mortality for IUI-COH.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was a measured maternal outcome, but specific findings related to mode of birth are not explicitly detailed in the abstract's results.
